		<summary type="html"><div class="mw-content-ltr mw-parser-output" lang="en" dir="ltr"><div class="mw-parser-output">
<p><b><a href="/wiki/October_18" title="October 18">October 18</a></b>: <b><a href="/wiki/Double_Ninth_Festival" title="Double Ninth Festival">Double Ninth Festival</a></b> in China (2026); <b><a href="/wiki/Alaska_Day" title="Alaska Day">Alaska Day</a></b>
</p>
<div style="float:right;margin-left:0.5em;" id="mp-otd-img">
<div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 122px;">
<span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:JohannesBrahms.jpg" class="mw-file-description" title="Johannes Brahms"><img alt="Johannes Brahms" src="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/JohannesBrahms.jpg/250px-JohannesBrahms.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="122" height="160" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="1462" data-file-height="1914" /></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word;">Johannes Brahms</div></div></div>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/1356" title="1356">1356</a> – The most significant earthquake to have occurred in Central Europe in recorded history <b><a href="/wiki/1356_Basel_earthquake" title="1356 Basel earthquake">destroyed</a></b> <a href="/wiki/Basel" title="Basel">Basel</a>, Switzerland.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1887" title="1887">1887</a> – <a href="/wiki/Johannes_Brahms" title="Johannes Brahms">Johannes Brahms</a> <i>(pictured)</i> conducted the premiere of his <b><a href="/wiki/Double_Concerto_(Brahms)" title="Double Concerto (Brahms)">Double Concerto</a></b>, composed for violinist <a href="/wiki/Joseph_Joachim" title="Joseph Joachim">Joseph Joachim</a> and cellist <a href="/wiki/Robert_Hausmann" title="Robert Hausmann">Robert Hausmann</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1943" title="1943">1943</a> – <b><a href="/wiki/Pere_Areny" title="Pere Areny">Pere Areny</a></b>, convicted of the murder of his brother, became the last person to be executed by <a href="/wiki/Andorra" title="Andorra">Andorra</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1963" title="1963">1963</a> – The first cat in space, later known as <b><a href="/wiki/F%C3%A9licette" title="Félicette">Félicette</a></b>, launched aboard a French <a href="/wiki/V%C3%A9ronique_(rocket)" title="Véronique (rocket)">Véronique rocket</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/2019" title="2019">2019</a> – Protests in <a href="/wiki/Santiago" title="Santiago">Santiago</a> that started 11 days prior <b><a href="/wiki/Social_Outburst_(Chile)" class="mw-redirect" title="Social Outburst (Chile)">escalated into open battle</a></b> against the <a href="/wiki/Carabineros_de_Chile" title="Carabineros de Chile">Chilean national police</a>, forcing President <a href="/wiki/Sebasti%C3%A1n_Pi%C3%B1era" title="Sebastián Piñera">Sebastián Piñera</a> to declare a state of emergency.</li></ul>

</p>
<div style="float:right;margin-left:0.5em;" id="mp-otd-img">
<div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 152px;">
<span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:Wilma_2005-10-19_1345Z.png" class="mw-file-description" title="Hurricane Wilma northeast of Honduras"><img alt="Hurricane Wilma northeast of Honduras" src="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/24/Wilma_2005-10-19_1345Z.png/250px-Wilma_2005-10-19_1345Z.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="152" height="129" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/24/Wilma_2005-10-19_1345Z.png/330px-Wilma_2005-10-19_1345Z.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="2000" data-file-height="1700" /></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word;">Hurricane Wilma northeast of Honduras</div></div></div>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/1864" title="1864">1864</a> – <a href="/wiki/American_Civil_War" title="American Civil War">American Civil War</a>: Despite incurring nearly twice as many casualties as the <a href="/wiki/Confederate_States_Army" title="Confederate States Army">Confederates</a>, the <a href="/wiki/Union_army" title="Union army">Union army</a> emerged victorious at the <b><a href="/wiki/Battle_of_Cedar_Creek" title="Battle of Cedar Creek">Battle of Cedar Creek</a></b>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1955" title="1955">1955</a> – At a meeting of its general assembly, the <a href="/wiki/European_Broadcasting_Union" title="European Broadcasting Union">European Broadcasting Union</a> <b><a href="/wiki/History_of_the_Eurovision_Song_Contest" title="History of the Eurovision Song Contest">approved the staging</a></b> of the first <a href="/wiki/Eurovision_Song_Contest" title="Eurovision Song Contest">Eurovision Song Contest</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1965" title="1965">1965</a> – <a href="/wiki/Vietnam_War" title="Vietnam War">Vietnam War</a>: The <b><a href="/wiki/Siege_of_Plei_Me" title="Siege of Plei Me">Siege of Plei Me</a></b> began with the first major confrontation between soldiers of the <a href="/wiki/People%27s_Army_of_Vietnam" title="People&#39;s Army of Vietnam">North Vietnamese Army</a> and the U.S. Army.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/2005" title="2005">2005</a> – <b><a href="/wiki/Hurricane_Wilma" title="Hurricane Wilma">Hurricane Wilma</a></b> <i>(pictured)</i> became the most intense <a href="/wiki/Atlantic_hurricane" title="Atlantic hurricane">Atlantic hurricane</a> on record with a minimum <a href="/wiki/Atmospheric_pressure" title="Atmospheric pressure">atmospheric pressure</a> of 882&#160;<a href="/wiki/Bar_(unit)" title="Bar (unit)">mbar</a> (26.05&#160;<a href="/wiki/Inch_of_mercury" title="Inch of mercury">inHg</a>).</li></ul>

<div style="float:right;margin-left:0.5em;" id="mp-otd-img">
<div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 117px;">
<span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:Mahamat_D%C3%A9by.jpg" class="mw-file-description" title="Mahamat Déby"><img alt="Mahamat Déby" src="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/94/Mahamat_D%C3%A9by.jpg/120px-Mahamat_D%C3%A9by.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="117" height="168" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/9/94/Mahamat_D%C3%A9by.jpg/250px-Mahamat_D%C3%A9by.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="267" data-file-height="383" /></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word;">Mahamat Déby</div></div></div>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/1936" title="1936">1936</a> – British woman <b><a href="/wiki/Mabel_Freer" title="Mabel Freer">Mabel Freer</a></b> was refused entry to Australia after failing a dictation test given in Italian, leading to a debate over Australia's immigration policy.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1944" title="1944">1944</a> – <a href="/wiki/World_War_II" title="World War II">World War&#160;II</a>: Fulfilling a promise he made <a href="/wiki/Douglas_MacArthur%27s_escape_from_the_Philippines" title="Douglas MacArthur&#39;s escape from the Philippines">two years previously</a>, General <a href="/wiki/Douglas_MacArthur" title="Douglas MacArthur">Douglas MacArthur</a> <b><a href="/wiki/Battle_of_Leyte" title="Battle of Leyte">landed on Leyte</a></b> to begin the <a href="/wiki/Philippines_campaign_(1944%E2%80%931945)" title="Philippines campaign (1944–1945)">recapture of the Philippines</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1986" title="1986">1986</a> – Soviet <b><a href="/wiki/Aeroflot_Flight_6502" title="Aeroflot Flight 6502">Aeroflot Flight 6502</a></b> crashed after <a href="/wiki/Runway_excursion" title="Runway excursion">overrunning the runway</a> at <a href="/wiki/Kurumoch_International_Airport" title="Kurumoch International Airport">Kuibyshev Airport</a>, killing 70 people on board.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/2022" title="2022">2022</a> – <b><a href="/wiki/2022_Chadian_protests" title="2022 Chadian protests">Protests</a></b> broke out across Chad after President <a href="/wiki/Mahamat_D%C3%A9by" title="Mahamat Déby">Mahamat Déby</a> <i>(pictured)</i> declared his intentions to extend his rule by another two years.</li></ul>

<ul><li><a href="/wiki/1096" title="1096">1096</a> – <a href="/wiki/First_Crusade" title="First Crusade">First Crusade</a>: At the <b><a href="/wiki/Battle_of_Civetot" title="Battle of Civetot">Battle of Civetot</a></b>, the <a href="/wiki/Seljuk_dynasty" title="Seljuk dynasty">Seljuk</a> forces of <a href="/wiki/Kilij_Arslan_I" title="Kilij Arslan I">Kilij Arslan</a> destroyed the army of the <b><a href="/wiki/People%27s_Crusade" title="People&#39;s Crusade">People's Crusade</a></b> as it marched toward <a href="/wiki/%C4%B0znik" title="İznik">Nicaea</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1854" title="1854">1854</a> – <b><a href="/wiki/Florence_Nightingale" title="Florence Nightingale">Florence Nightingale</a></b> and a staff of 38 nurses and 15 nuns were sent to the <a href="/wiki/Ottoman_Empire" title="Ottoman Empire">Ottoman Empire</a> to help treat wounded British soldiers fighting in the <a href="/wiki/Crimean_War" title="Crimean War">Crimean War</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1966" title="1966">1966</a> – A <a href="/wiki/Spoil_tip" title="Spoil tip">coal tip</a> <b><a href="/wiki/Aberfan_disaster" title="Aberfan disaster">fell</a></b> on the village of <a href="/wiki/Aberfan" title="Aberfan">Aberfan</a>, Wales, killing 144 people, mostly schoolchildren.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1994" title="1994">1994</a> – In <a href="/wiki/Seoul" title="Seoul">Seoul</a>, South Korea, 32 people were killed and 17 others injured when <b><a href="/wiki/Seongsu_Bridge_disaster" title="Seongsu Bridge disaster">a span of the Seongsu Bridge collapsed</a></b> <i>(pictured)</i>.</li></ul>

<div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 128px;">
<span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:Train_wreck_at_Montparnasse_1895.jpg" class="mw-file-description" title="Montparnasse derailment"><img alt="Montparnasse derailment" src="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/19/Train_wreck_at_Montparnasse_1895.jpg/250px-Train_wreck_at_Montparnasse_1895.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="128" height="154" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/19/Train_wreck_at_Montparnasse_1895.jpg/330px-Train_wreck_at_Montparnasse_1895.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="1750" data-file-height="2100" /></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word;">Montparnasse derailment</div></div></div>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/906" title="906">906</a> – <b><a href="/wiki/Ahmad_ibn_Kayghalagh" title="Ahmad ibn Kayghalagh">Ahmad ibn Kayghalagh</a></b>, an <a href="/wiki/Abbasid_Caliphate" title="Abbasid Caliphate">Abbasid</a> military officer of <a href="/wiki/Turkic_peoples" title="Turkic peoples">Turkic</a> origin, led a raid against the <a href="/wiki/Byzantine_Empire" title="Byzantine Empire">Byzantine Empire</a>, taking at least 4,000 captives.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1895" title="1895">1895</a> – At <a href="/wiki/Gare_Montparnasse" title="Gare Montparnasse">Gare Montparnasse</a> in Paris, an express train <b><a href="/wiki/Montparnasse_derailment" title="Montparnasse derailment">derailed</a></b> after overrunning the <a href="/wiki/Buffer_stop" title="Buffer stop">buffer stop</a> and crashed through the station wall <i>(pictured)</i>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1936" title="1936">1936</a> – <a href="/wiki/Dod_Orsborne" title="Dod Orsborne">Dod Orsborne</a>, captain of the <a href="/wiki/Fishing_trawler" title="Fishing trawler">fishing trawler</a> <i><b><a href="/wiki/Girl_Pat" title="Girl Pat">Girl Pat</a></b></i>, was convicted of its theft and imprisoned, having caused a media sensation when it went missing.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1966" title="1966">1966</a> – With their album <i><a href="/wiki/The_Supremes_A%27_Go-Go" title="The Supremes A&#39; Go-Go">The Supremes A' Go-Go</a></i>, <b><a href="/wiki/The_Supremes" title="The Supremes">the Supremes</a></b> became the first all-female group to reach number one on the <a href="/wiki/Billboard_200" title="Billboard 200"><i>Billboard</i>&#160;200</a> chart.</li></ul>

</p>
<div style="float:right;margin-left:0.5em;" id="mp-otd-img">
<div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 114px;">
<span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:Marco_Simoncelli,_Silverstone_2011.jpg" class="mw-file-description" title="Marco Simoncelli in 2011"><img alt="Marco Simoncelli in 2011" src="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/39/Marco_Simoncelli%2C_Silverstone_2011.jpg/120px-Marco_Simoncelli%2C_Silverstone_2011.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="114" height="171" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/39/Marco_Simoncelli%2C_Silverstone_2011.jpg/250px-Marco_Simoncelli%2C_Silverstone_2011.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="2016" data-file-height="3024" /></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word;">Marco Simoncelli in 2011</div></div></div>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/1157" title="1157">1157</a> – The <b><a href="/wiki/Battle_of_Grathe_Heath" title="Battle of Grathe Heath">Battle of Grathe Heath</a></b> ended the <a href="/wiki/Danish_Civil_Wars" title="Danish Civil Wars">Danish Civil War</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1906" title="1906">1906</a> – <b><a href="/wiki/Alberto_Santos-Dumont" title="Alberto Santos-Dumont">Alberto Santos-Dumont</a></b> flew his <a href="/wiki/Biplane" title="Biplane">biplane</a> <i><b><a href="/wiki/Santos-Dumont_14-bis" title="Santos-Dumont 14-bis"><span class="nowrap">14-bis</span></a></b></i> for 50 metres (160&#160;ft) at an altitude of about four metres (13&#160;ft).</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1956" title="1956">1956</a> – The <b><a href="/wiki/Hungarian_Revolution_of_1956" title="Hungarian Revolution of 1956">Hungarian Revolution</a></b> began as a peaceful <a href="/wiki/Student_activism" title="Student activism">student demonstration</a> that attracted thousands while marching through central Budapest to <a href="/wiki/Hungarian_Parliament_Building" title="Hungarian Parliament Building">the parliament building</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/2011" title="2011">2011</a> – During the <b><a href="/wiki/2011_Malaysian_motorcycle_Grand_Prix" title="2011 Malaysian motorcycle Grand Prix">Malaysian motorcycle Grand Prix</a></b>, <a href="/wiki/Marco_Simoncelli" title="Marco Simoncelli">Marco Simoncelli</a> <i>(pictured)</i> collided with two other riders, resulting in his death due to serious trauma to the head, neck, and chest.</li></ul>

</p>
<div style="float:right;margin-left:0.5em;" id="mp-otd-img">
<div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 156px;">
<span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:GW_Bridge.jpg" class="mw-file-description" title="George Washington Bridge"><img alt="George Washington Bridge" src="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6e/GW_Bridge.jpg/250px-GW_Bridge.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="156" height="126" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6e/GW_Bridge.jpg/330px-GW_Bridge.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="1200" data-file-height="972" /></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word;">George Washington Bridge</div></div></div>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/1789" title="1789">1789</a> – The <b><a href="/wiki/Brabant_Revolution" title="Brabant Revolution">Brabant Revolution</a></b>, sometimes considered to be the first expression of <a href="/wiki/Belgian_nationalism" title="Belgian nationalism">Belgian nationalism</a>, began with the invasion of the <a href="/wiki/Austrian_Netherlands" title="Austrian Netherlands">Austrian Netherlands</a> by an <i><a href="/wiki/%C3%89migr%C3%A9" title="Émigré">émigré</a></i> army from the <a href="/wiki/Dutch_Republic" title="Dutch Republic">Dutch Republic</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1851" title="1851">1851</a> – <b><a href="/wiki/Umbriel" title="Umbriel">Umbriel</a></b> and <b><a href="/wiki/Ariel_(moon)" title="Ariel (moon)">Ariel</a></b>, the third- and fourth-largest <a href="/wiki/Moons_of_Uranus" title="Moons of Uranus">moons of Uranus</a>, were discovered by <a href="/wiki/William_Lassell" title="William Lassell">William Lassell</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1931" title="1931">1931</a> – The <b><a href="/wiki/George_Washington_Bridge" title="George Washington Bridge">George Washington Bridge</a></b> <i>(pictured)</i>, connecting <a href="/wiki/Manhattan" title="Manhattan">Manhattan</a>, New York City, to <a href="/wiki/Fort_Lee,_New_Jersey" title="Fort Lee, New Jersey">Fort Lee, New Jersey</a>, and today the world's busiest motor-vehicle bridge, was dedicated.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1964" title="1964">1964</a> – Charges in a military court against generals <b><a href="/wiki/D%C6%B0%C6%A1ng_V%C4%83n_%C4%90%E1%BB%A9c" title="Dương Văn Đức">Dương Văn Đức</a></b> and <b><a href="/wiki/L%C3%A2m_V%C4%83n_Ph%C3%A1t" title="Lâm Văn Phát">Lâm Văn Phát</a></b> of leading <a href="/wiki/September_1964_South_Vietnamese_coup_attempt" title="September 1964 South Vietnamese coup attempt">a coup attempt</a> against <a href="/wiki/South_Vietnam" title="South Vietnam">South Vietnamese</a> leader <a href="/wiki/Nguy%E1%BB%85n_Kh%C3%A1nh" title="Nguyễn Khánh">Nguyễn Khánh</a> were dropped.</li></ul>

<span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:Statue_of_Industry_at_the_North_East_Coast_Exhibition_after_tarring.jpg" class="mw-file-description" title="Students dancing around Statue of Industry after tarring and feathering it"><img alt="Students dancing around Statue of Industry after tarring and feathering it" src="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f0/Statue_of_Industry_at_the_North_East_Coast_Exhibition_after_tarring.jpg/250px-Statue_of_Industry_at_the_North_East_Coast_Exhibition_after_tarring.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="159" height="123" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/f0/Statue_of_Industry_at_the_North_East_Coast_Exhibition_after_tarring.jpg/330px-Statue_of_Industry_at_the_North_East_Coast_Exhibition_after_tarring.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="1024" data-file-height="795" /></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word;">Students dancing around <i>Statue of Industry</i> after tarring and feathering it</div></div></div>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/1616" title="1616">1616</a> – Dutch explorer <a href="/wiki/Dirk_Hartog" title="Dirk Hartog">Dirk Hartog</a> left <b><a href="/wiki/Hartog_Plate" title="Hartog Plate">a plate</a></b> on <a href="/wiki/Dirk_Hartog_Island" title="Dirk Hartog Island">an island</a> in <a href="/wiki/Shark_Bay" title="Shark Bay">Shark Bay</a>, the oldest-known artefact of European exploration in Australia still in existence.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1864" title="1864">1864</a> – <a href="/wiki/American_Civil_War" title="American Civil War">American Civil War</a>: During <a href="/wiki/Price%27s_Missouri_Expedition" title="Price&#39;s Missouri Expedition">Price's Missouri Expedition</a>, Union troops defeated <a href="/wiki/Sterling_Price" title="Sterling Price">Sterling Price</a>'s Confederate army in three successive battles: <b><a href="/wiki/Battle_of_Marais_des_Cygnes" title="Battle of Marais des Cygnes">Marais des Cygnes</a></b>, <b><a href="/wiki/Battle_of_Mine_Creek" title="Battle of Mine Creek">Mine Creek</a></b>, and <b><a href="/wiki/Battle_of_Marmiton_River" title="Battle of Marmiton River">Marmiton River</a></b>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1929" title="1929">1929</a> – Hundreds of students at <a href="/wiki/Colleges_of_Durham_University#Colleges_in_Newcastle" title="Colleges of Durham University">Armstrong College</a> in <a href="/wiki/Newcastle_upon_Tyne" title="Newcastle upon Tyne">Newcastle</a>, England, <a href="/wiki/Tarring_and_feathering" title="Tarring and feathering">tarred and feathered</a> <i><b><a href="/wiki/Statue_of_Industry" title="Statue of Industry">Statue of Industry</a></b></i> <i>(pictured)</i>, a sculpture by <a href="/wiki/Herbert_Maryon" title="Herbert Maryon">Herbert Maryon</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/2001" title="2001">2001</a> – <b><a href="/wiki/Windows_XP" title="Windows XP">Windows XP</a></b>, one of the most popular and widely used versions of the <a href="/wiki/Microsoft_Windows" title="Microsoft Windows">Microsoft Windows</a> operating system, was released for retail sale.</li></ul>

		<summary type="html"><div class="mw-content-ltr mw-parser-output" lang="en" dir="ltr"><div class="mw-parser-output">
<p><b><a href="/wiki/October_26" title="October 26">October 26</a></b>
</p>
<div style="float:right;margin-left:0.5em;" id="mp-otd-img">
<div class="thumbinner mp-thumb" style="background: transparent; color: inherit; border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 118px;">
<span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:Edward_James_Roye_c._1850.jpg" class="mw-file-description" title="Edward Roye"><img alt="Edward Roye" src="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b8/Edward_James_Roye_c._1850.jpg/120px-Edward_James_Roye_c._1850.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="118" height="165" class="mw-file-element" srcset="//thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b8/Edward_James_Roye_c._1850.jpg/250px-Edward_James_Roye_c._1850.jpg?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&amp;utm_campaign=parser&amp;utm_content=thumbnail 2x" data-file-width="2668" data-file-height="3733" /></a></span><div class="thumbcaption" style="padding: 0.25em 0; word-wrap: break-word;">Edward Roye</div></div></div>
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/1341" title="1341">1341</a> – The <a href="/wiki/Byzantine_Empire" title="Byzantine Empire">Byzantine</a> army proclaimed chief minister <a href="/wiki/John_VI_Kantakouzenos" title="John VI Kantakouzenos">John&#160;VI Kantakouzenos</a> as emperor, triggering <b><a href="/wiki/Byzantine_civil_war_of_1341%E2%80%931347" title="Byzantine civil war of 1341–1347">a civil war</a></b> between his supporters and those of <a href="/wiki/John_V_Palaiologos" title="John V Palaiologos">John&#160;V Palaiologos</a>, the heir to the throne.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1871" title="1871">1871</a> – Liberian president <a href="/wiki/Edward_James_Roye" title="Edward James Roye">Edward James Roye</a> <i>(pictured)</i> <b><a href="/wiki/1871_Liberian_coup_d%27%C3%A9tat" title="1871 Liberian coup d&#39;état">was overthrown</a></b> in modern Africa's first coup d'état.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1906" title="1906">1906</a> – The <b><a href="/wiki/Illinois_Memorial" title="Illinois Memorial">Illinois Memorial</a></b>, honoring <a href="/wiki/Union_army" title="Union army">Union army</a> soldiers from <a href="/wiki/Illinois" title="Illinois">Illinois</a> who fought at the <a href="/wiki/Siege_of_Vicksburg" title="Siege of Vicksburg">Siege of Vicksburg</a>, was dedicated at <a href="/wiki/Vicksburg_National_Military_Park" title="Vicksburg National Military Park">Vicksburg National Military Park</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/1994" title="1994">1994</a> – Israel and Jordan signed <b><a href="/wiki/Israel%E2%80%93Jordan_peace_treaty" title="Israel–Jordan peace treaty">a peace treaty</a></b>, settling <a href="/wiki/Israel%E2%80%93Jordan_relations" title="Israel–Jordan relations">relations between the two countries</a> and pledging that neither would allow its territory to become a staging ground for military strikes by a third country.</li></ul>
